integrity: The all-length assertion is supported by a written combinatorial proof; finite independent checks are corroborative rather than infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact minimum cover length for the binary language avoiding contiguous 111, all window sizes k>=3; the covering cycle may be unrestricted. This does not count optimal cycles, treat other forbidden sets, or establish novelty against every inaccessible or unindexed source.
title: A Fibonacci–Tribonacci law for shortest cyclic covers of the binary no-triple-one language
